title: From Top to Bottom: Quark Mass Hierarchies in Heterotic String Theory
abstract: arXiv:2611.21751v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard Model fermion masses exhibit large hierarchies, spanning more than five orders of magnitude in the quark sector alone. In this paper, we study whether these hierarchies can be generated perturbatively at tree level in smooth heterotic Calabi-Yau compactifications, where the supergravity approximation remains under computational control. In such backgrounds, physical Yukawa couplings combine holomorphic superpotential integrals with matter field Kahler metrics. The former can be computed algebraically, while the latter require solving a coupled system of partial differential equations for the Ricci-flat metric, Hermitian Yang-Mills connections, and harmonic bundle-valued forms. Within this framework, we identify two new tree-level mechanisms by which complex structure moduli can generate fermion mass hierarchies and show analytically and numerically that both mechanisms are obstructed for previously studied tetra-quadric models

translated_title: 从顶到底：杂化弦理论中的夸克质量层级结构
translated_abstract: 标准模型费米子质量表现出巨大的层级结构，仅在夸克部分就跨越了五个数量级以上。本文研究了这些层级结构是否可以在光滑的杂化卡拉比-丘紧化中以树级微扰方式产生，其中超引力近似保持在计算可控范围内。在这类背景下，物理汤川耦合由全纯超势积分与物质场凯勒度规共同决定。前者可以通过代数方法计算，而后者需要求解关于里奇平度规、厄米杨-米尔斯联络以及谐和丛值形式的耦合偏微分方程组。在此框架内，我们识别出两种新的树级机制，复结构模可通过这些机制产生费米子质量层级，并通过解析和数值方法证明，对于先前研究的四重二次曲面模型，这两种机制均受到阻碍。
tldr: 论文在光滑杂化卡拉比-丘紧化框架中识别出复结构模产生费米子质量层级的两种新树级机制，但解析与数值结果表明这两种机制在先前研究的四重二次曲面模型中均无法实现。
